notes.title: Update v1.08 - New Box Dimensions
notes.content:
📦 [b]Two Exciting Updates Are Here![/b]
Hello, dear players!
We are thrilled to bring you two new features to enhance your gameplay experience. Here are the details:

✨ [b]1st Update: Different Box Sizes[/b]
Now you can ship your products using different box sizes! Instead of being limited to a single box size, you can now work with three options:
[list]
[*] Small Box: Perfect for smaller products.
[*] Medium Box: Ideal for standard products.
[*] Large Box: Ready for big orders.
[/list]

🎮 [b]How to Use?[/b]
[list]
[*] Click on the box icon on the right to select the desired box size.
[*] Use keyboard shortcuts for quick access:
[*] Press 1 for a small box, 2 for a medium box, and 3 for a large box.
[*] You can also customize the box selection panel via the Settings menu.
[/list]

✨ [b]2nd Update: Worker Automation[/b]
Your worker can now prepare incoming orders for you!

🎮 [b]How Does It Work?[/b]
[list]
[*] Activate the “Worker Automation” feature on the left side of the Orders screen.
[*] Once activated, your worker will automatically accept and prepare orders up to their capacity, then move on to the next.
[*] While this feature is active, you can still take over any unclaimed orders manually.
[/list]

📋 [b]If Deactivated?[/b]
If the feature is turned off, any orders left by the worker will be assigned to you, just like before.

notes.title: Level Up! v1.05 and Steam Community Items Are Live!
notes.content:
[h2]🎉 Level Up! v1.05 is Live! 🎮[/h2]

Hello everyone! 🚀 We’re thrilled to announce the release of v1.05 for our game. This update not only fixes major bugs and improves overall gameplay experience but also sets the stage for big surprises coming pretty soon that will knock your socks off! Stay tuned – you will not want to miss what we have planned.👀🎁
[h2]🔧🐞Major Bug Fixes and Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Negative Stock Reset: All items in negative stock have been reset to zero. If a negative item is assigned to a worker, they will take the required amount one-time only, and it will be removed upon order completion. For player-assigned negative items, you’ll prepare and send them once, and they will reset to zero in stock. This ensures no future issues with negative stocks!
[*] Fixed a crash issue when extending the day using the day extension skill.
[*] Resolved saving issues during customer review generation after product deliveries.
[*] Eliminated glitches with packaged items when transitioning to the packaging table.
[*] Fixed an outline display issue on already packaged items.
[*] Addressed a bug where pre-packaged items couldn’t be placed in boxes upon reloading the game.
[/list]
[h2]🎉 Steam Community Items Are Live! 🚀[/h2]
We are thrilled to announce that Beff Jezos Simulator now features exclusive Steam Community Items! 🏆 This is a huge milestone, made possible by the amazing support and enthusiasm of our community. 🎮
[list]
[*] Trading Cards: Collect, trade, and craft unique cards to show off your Beff Jezos pride!
[*] Badges: Flaunt your entrepreneurial achievements with specially designed badges.
[*] Profile Backgrounds: Customize your Steam profile with stunning Beff Jezos-themed backgrounds.
[*] Emoticons: Spice up your chats and comments with stylish, game-inspired emoticons.
[/list]
[h2]🛠️ Additional Adjustments:[/h2]
[list]
[*] We’ve implemented various tweaks to ensure smoother gameplay and a better overall experience.
[*] Updated the dimensions of some products inside boxes for better consistency.
[*] Optimized the game's infrastructure to support major upcoming features and expansions! 🛍️
[/list]
Thank you for your patience and support! If you encounter any new bugs or have feedback, let us know! Please don't forget to share your love by spreading the word and leaving a review on Steam! Happy gaming! 🎮✨

Cheers,

The Beff Jezos Simulator Team
